newsitem.title: EGYPT: Banks send Egypt bourse down as profit taking hits.
newsitem.headline: Banks send Egypt bourse down as profit taking hits.

text.p: Encroaching profit taking spread on Tuesday to the Egyptian banking sector and sent the market off Monday's freak record close, brokers said.
The Capital Market Authority (CMA) said the all-share index fell 3.72 points to 424.05 from Monday's record 427.77 points. The market had closed lower two days previously due to profit taking.
Turnover was a heavy 134.15 million pounds ($39.5 million), dominated by trading in PACHIN/Paints and Chemical Industries and blue-chip realty firm Medinet Nasr Housing and Development.

"Yesterday's level was unusual in the profit taking trend. The market is certainly due for a correction for it to remain attractive and I'm advising my clients that now is the time to sell part of their portfolios and cash it in," said a top-level market analyst.

The banks, which drove the market to Monday's record high, ended mostly lower and dragged the market down with them. Commercial International Bank (CIB) fell 7.29 to 970 in trading worth almost 10 million pounds and Misr International Bank/MIBANK followed suit, shedding 48 to 927.
Egyptian American Bank (EAB) also lost 10.5 pounds to 201.99 pounds.

PACHIN, the day's most active share, also closed 3 pounds lower at 157 after shares worth more than 16 million pounds traded. Public Enterprise Minister Atef Obeid had said that the state would offer another share tranche to anchor investors.
Medinet Nasr, the second most active share, fell 2 pounds to 480 in deals worth more than 11.4 million pounds.
Millers also tended down, with the most active share, Central and West Delta Flour Mills closing unchanged at 125. Central Egypt Flour Mills lost 3.36 to 64.15.
Amriyah Cement which was rising on the back of a positive report from HSBC James Capel, also fell 1.5 to 89.
The index for openly traded firms rose to fell to 738.19 points from 753.00 on Monday and the index for rarely traded "closed" firms also shed 0.12 points to 271.11.
Out of the 82 shares traded, 29 gained, 31 lost and 22 ended the day unchanged.
